newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: INSTANT VIEW - Proton, Hicom 6-mth results.
newsitem.headline: INSTANT VIEW - Proton, Hicom 6-mth results.

text.p: Following is a selection of views by auto analysts of the six-month profit results for automaker Perusahaan Otomobil Nasional Bhd, and parent Hicom Holdings Bhd.
CHOO SWEE KEE, AUTO ANALYST AT VICKERS BALLAS

The pre-tax profit was generally in line with our expectations, It should have a minimal impact on the share price. The second half of the year should be roughly comparable to the first half, even though the yen is expected to firm slightly. If the rise in the yen is less than five percent, Proton should be able to maintain its margins.
JOHN ENGLE, MANAGING DIRECTOR OF HG ASIA

The results for Hicom include the acquisition of Automotive Corporation (a distributor of Isuzu vehicles), and United Straits Fuso (a distributor of Mitsubishi vehicles). The yen is going to have far less of an impact in the second half, than in the first half. Most of the impact will come from efficiency gains and lower cost of component parts.

Proton achieved its full year pre-tax profits for the previous year in their first half. In the second half, their continued strong performance will depend on their sustaining unit sales. They probably will be able to do this. If they maintain the momentum of their unit sales, they will be OK.
